acceptance_criteria.text: Before affected host writes, MT210 has its actual independent source review, nonzero owning public-API proof and independently reread canonical publication; bind an explicit immutable source revision/tree, source files, dependency/lock and maintenance references.

Support Cargo declares the exact pinned published dependency; its compiled_schema_catalog_entries module re-exports the shared API. Core schema.rs uses that shared API for BOTH strict compiled/base and ordered production-overlay wrappers, removing the private per-line recognizer without a second parser or host-only workaround.

Host-owned expected names/counts, original source ordering, declaration identities, raw-source/catalog hash inputs and schema166 lineage remain intact. Preserve distinct duplicate/modifier/count policies and original INFO/historical pins; no invented body-replacement semantics or SQL flattening.

The existing owning MT139 schema observation plus fresh/reopen integration proof passes on the changed pinned host inputs under its real admission and independent owner. Preserve all original runtime/GUI/three-WP acceptance; compilation or source publication alone does not complete it.
